description: A lazily built, paginated list of `item` templates over `items`, with empty, loading and error states (WGT-012).

props.name: items
props.description: The items loaded so far; the template repeats over them as `item` and `index`.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading, error or ready; selects the `loading` or `error` slot.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More items can be loaded; `onEndReached` fires near the end.

events.name: onEndReached
events.description: Fires once when the last item comes into view and `hasMore` is true.

slots.name: item
slots.description: The template built for each item, lazily.
